maria_ledger: Heads-up — ACME Corp (onprem) invoice 987654 shows ~2x expected usage this billing period. Customer flagged it and pushed back. cc @ajay_ops @sarah_revops

ajay_ops: Looking now. We had a short spike on Mar 10 around 14:02 UTC during their bulk data import. Suspect KV cache TTL regen led to repeated cold-starts and extra GPU minutes.

sarah_revops: What's the invoice window? Do we have a units breakdown (gpu_hours, tokens, platform_fee)?

ajay_ops: Invoice covers 2026-02-25 → 2026-03-24. Quick query to get GPU minutes by host:

```sql
SELECT host_id, SUM(gpu_minutes) AS gpu_mins
FROM metering.events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-corp' AND ts >= '2026-02-25' AND ts <= '2026-03-24'
GROUP BY host_id
ORDER BY gpu_mins DESC;
```

maria_ledger: billing-bot: invoice 987654 created 2026-03-25 09:15 UTC — total $48,302. Platform fee $5,000, usage $43,302. Customer says they expected ~ $24k based on committed capacity.

price-bot: FYI — possible known issue: onprem metering aggregator v1.3.2 can double-count instances that briefly lose heartbeat -> duplicates. Tracking ticket BILL-0172: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-0172

sarah_revops: We should propose a customer-facing mitigation. I suggest provisional credit while we reconcile. How much do we want to offer upfront?

maria_ledger: Proposing provisional credit of $20,000 pending reconciliation. Note: credits > $10k need @james_cfo approval.

james_cfo: Approved provisional credit up to $25,000 — please document rationale and mark as "subject to reconciliation" :white_check_mark:

ajay_ops: Root cause confirmed: heartbeat TTL misconfig in the aggregator. Patch landed in infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1284. We'll run a dedupe/backfill for the ACME window to produce reconciled usage.

maria_ledger: I'll issue credit note CN-2026-004 for $20,000 now and reissue invoice 987654-R1 for $28,302 (after credit). Draft email to customer: 

"""
Hi ACME team,

We identified duplicated metering for part of your billing window and are issuing a provisional credit of $20,000 while we complete a reconciliation. You'll receive an adjusted invoice and a follow-up report within 3 business days.

Thanks,
Maria (Billing)
"""

ajay_ops: Running the dedupe backfill now; will post results to #eng-infra and follow up with the exact reconciled delta. Monitoring for 48h to ensure no repeat duplication.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-0172 transitioned to in_progress by ajay_ops at 1861234595

maria_ledger: Notifying ACME and recording the provisional credit. Keeping this thread for audit and follow-up.
